Voting ignores this intra-receipt corroboration and picks the OCR-majority wrong value."},{"id":"RC2","summary":"Ambiguity between 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' and the final rounded 'TOTAL:' line","detail":"Some receipts show an inclusive-of-GST total followed by a rounding adjustment and a final 'TOTAL:' value differing by a few cents. The generic TOTAL tier treats both as equal matches; without preferring the last (rounded) TOTAL after rounding adjustments, the wrong value is chosen."},{"id":"RC3","summary":"Two-line fallback for keyword-only lines is too restrictive and/or exclusion set is incomplete for payment-adjacent lines","detail":"When the keyword line loses its number due to OCR, the fallback (take last number on next line) can pick up payment lines like 'Cash Received', 'Visa RM', or 'Mastercard'. Early iterations missed 'Cash Received'; conversely tightening fallback to only pure-keyword lines caused 078 to return null when the Grand Total line was mangled with stray characters but no valid digits."},{"id":"RC4","summary":"Date extractor has no disambiguation when multiple date-like substrings exist","detail":"Receipts contain additional numeric strings (GST IDs, invoice numbers, phone numbers) that can match loose date patterns; without anchoring on 'Date:' labels or scoring by proximity to date keywords, the parser can pick a false positive and misinterpret DD/MM vs MM/DD."},{"id":"RC5","summary":"No post-selection sanity check against subtotal + tax + rounding","detail":"The pipeline doesn't validate the chosen total against subtotal + GST/SST + rounding adjustment present on the same receipt, which would have caught the 702 vs 102 case and the 23.26 vs 23.25 case."}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Current candidate skill documents a priority-tier matcher and two-line fallback but does not mandate (a) cross-line corroboration via Subtotal/Payment/Cash agreement, (b) preference for the final rounded TOTAL after a 'Rounding Adj' line, (c) a sanity check that selected total ≈ subtotal + tax ± rounding, or (d) a robust fallback rule that distinguishes pure-keyword lines from garbled-number lines without silently returning payment amounts."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Exclusion list in the skill text enumerates CASH TENDERED but not CASH RECEIVED, CASH PAYMENT, VISA, MASTERCARD, DEBIT, CREDIT, CARD, PAID, TENDER, ROUNDING, ROUNDED (as a standalone label), AVERAGE / PAX, POINTS, CHANGE DUE — all of which have appeared as fallback traps on realistic receipts."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction section lacks guidance to prefer dates adjacent to 'Date', 'Tarikh', 'Invoice Date', 'Receipt Date', 'Bill Date' labels, and to reject date-like matches that overlap GST IDs, phone numbers, or invoice/transaction numbers. No DD/MM vs MM/DD disambiguation heuristic (e.g., first field >12 ⇒ DD/MM; year position; locale hint 'RM' ⇒ Malaysian DD/MM/YYYY)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Multi-pass OCR strategy does not specify a voting/arbitration policy that uses evidence from the same receipt (subtotal, payment, change) to break ties between OCR variants; defaults to simple frequency which is misleading when two variants share the same misread."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Skill does not describe a 'summary region' concept (lines after items, before footer) nor instruct to restrict keyword search to that region, which would reduce false matches on item descriptions containing 'TOTAL' or 'AMOUNT' as part of column headers."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"Guidance confirms writing strings for total_amount but does not warn specifically about pandas inferring float on empty-mixed columns or openpyxl writing a numeric cell when a Python float sneaks in; a stronger rule to force dtype=object and format with f'{v:.2f}' before assignment is needed for this class of OCR-to-Excel task."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"No explicit instruction that None/null fields must be written as truly empty cells (not the string 'None', not NaN rendered as text) and that the sheet must contain exactly the required columns in the required order with the required sheet name."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand the Receipt Field Extraction section to require a cross-line corroboration step: after selecting a candidate total T at the best available tier, count how many times T (or T within ±0.02) appears elsewhere in the OCR text as Subtotal, Total incl. GST, Payment, Cash, Rounded Total, Net Total, Amount Due. If an alternative tier-matched value T' has strictly more corroboration occurrences than T, prefer T'. Formalize this by scanning top-to-bottom and, within the same priority tier, taking the last match that is on or after a line matching a rounding indicator (ROUND, ROUNDING, ROUNDED, ADJ, NET)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Rewrite the two-line fallback rule precisely: trigger ONLY when the keyword line contains no digits AND the next non-empty line is not a payment/change/tax/discount/points line. Provide an explicit extended exclusion regex covering CASH\\s+(TENDERED|RECEIVED|PAYMENT|PAID)?, VISA, MASTER(CARD)?, DEBIT, CREDIT, CARD, TENDER(ED)?, PAID, CHANGE(\\s+DUE)?, ROUNDING(\\s+ADJ.*)?, POINTS, AVERAGE(\\s*/\\s*PAX)?, TAX, GST, SST, SUB\\s*TOTAL, DISCOUNT, SAVINGS."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'summary region' heuristic: locate the first line after the item table (detected by a run of lines containing a trailing numeric with 2 decimals plus a quantity column) and restrict total-keyword search to that region through the footer. Fall back to full-text search only if no candidates are found."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Strengthen date extraction with: (1) prefer matches on lines containing DATE, TARIKH, INVOICE DATE, RECEIPT DATE, BILL DATE, PRINT DATE; (2) if multiple matches, score by proximity to such labels and recency to the TOTAL region; (3) disambiguate ambiguous NN/NN/NNNN: if first group >12 ⇒ DD/MM; if second group >12 ⇒ MM/DD; otherwise default to DD/MM/YYYY for RM-denominated receipts and document this locale default; (4) reject date substrings that overlap known non-date fields (GST ID, phone, invoice number) by requiring a word boundary and not being part of a longer digit run."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a sanity-check pass: if subtotal S and tax T are detectable, require that |chosen_total − (S + T + rounding_adj)| ≤ 0.05; otherwise demote the chosen candidate and retry with the next candidate. Include a worked example and a note that simple cross-variant majority is insufficient when two variants share the same OCR misread."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Normalize numeric parsing: strip currency prefixes RM, MYR, $, and trailing letters/codes (S, SR, SRM, SRS, C, A, T) before parsing; accept comma thousands separators; collapse spaced decimals ('86 17'→'86.17' when flanked by RM-style context) only under a conservative rule to avoid over-correction; and reject values with implausible magnitudes (e.g., >100000 or <0.01) unless corroborated."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add explicit guidance that per-image failure must yield None for the failed field without raising, and that the output row must still be emitted; include a batch loop template that catches exceptions per file."},{"skill":"xlsx","change":"In the output-schema guidance for this family of tasks, require: single sheet named exactly as specified; columns in the exact order; sort rows by filename as strings; total_amount written as a Python str with exactly two decimals via f'{v:.2f}' and the column dtype forced to object before to_excel; date written as 'YYYY-MM-DD' string or None; None values written as truly empty cells (never 'None' or 'nan'); verify by reloading the workbook with openpyxl data_only=True and asserting the cell types and values match."},{"skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a short checklist: no extra sheets, no extra columns, no header renaming, no trailing blank rows; use pd.ExcelWriter with engine='openpyxl' and df.to_excel(..., index=False)."}],"confidence":0.72}
